descriptions.d25c_ledge_search_800d4b90: Read the descriptor from handle +136 and the two endpoint vectors. For i = 0..3 test (0x800d4cec) the angle +176 plus and then minus i * pi/4 with height +180; on success store angle and height through the two out pointers and return 1. Finally test the angle with the descriptor's height +64. Returns 0 when nothing fits.
